Maybe clicking the swatch selects the color and immediately applies it to the "active" box (the one with the gray border). Or maybe the box with the gray border is the "target" and clicking the swatch paints it.
Wait, actually maybe clicking the swatch selects the color and the gray-bordered box is the currently selected box, and clicking the swatch applies the color to it. That's what happened: the upper box became white.
Now the center: white box on top, white box on bottom. Goal: white on top, purple on bottom. So next I need to paint the lower box purple. But which box is "active"? The gray border is still on the upper box (node 11's g boundary is at [24,25]). Hmm, the gray border is still around the upper box. If the active box is the upper one, then clicking the purple swatch will paint the upper box purple — that's wrong.
Maybe I need to click the lower box to select it (move the gray border), and then click the purple swatch. Let me try clicking the lower white box (rows 34-43, cols 27-36, center ~row 38, col 31).
